Add spring discount codes to the order book

SPRING10 takes 10 % off an order's items, rounded half up to the cent;
WELCOME5 takes 5.00 € off an order whose items come to 30.00 € or more.
applyCode(orderNumber, code) gives an order one code, replacing any
earlier one, and refuses an unknown code or an unmet threshold, leaving
the order unchanged. Totals report discountCents; shipping is still
decided on the items before the discount.
